# Designmela

> Creative studio building websites, brand identity, AI tools, and business automation.

Designmela turns ideas into fast, responsive websites, custom web applications, visual brand identities, AI tools, and workflow automations — combining thoughtful design with modern web technology to build software and digital assets that work.

## Core Services

- [Website Design & Development](https://designmela.com/#services): Custom responsive websites built for speed, conversion, and seamless user experience.
- [Web Apps & Dashboards](https://designmela.com/#services): Interactive web applications, customer portals, and custom management dashboards.
- [Business Automation](https://designmela.com/#services): Custom workflow automations, API integrations, and process optimization to save manual effort.
- [Brand Identity & Logo Design](https://designmela.com/#services): Complete visual identity, logo design, color systems, typography, and brand assets.
- [AI Chatbots & Assistants](https://designmela.com/#services): Intelligent conversational chatbots, lead qualification engines, and AI workflow integration.
- [Copywriting & Ad Creatives](https://designmela.com/#services): High-converting marketing copy, social media ad visual design, and presentation decks.
